# Northwind Joinery

> Handmade solid wood kitchens, fitted wardrobes and bespoke furniture, made in Leeds.

## Services

Northwind Joinery designs, makes and fits solid wood kitchens and fitted wardrobes for homes within 40 miles of Leeds. Every piece is made to measure in our workshop.

## How long does a handmade kitchen take?

From the measuring visit to fitting, a handmade kitchen usually takes eight to twelve weeks. Design takes one to two weeks, making four to six, and fitting one to two.
